deviations: Harness Python: the protocol example names python3.13, which is not installed here; the harness venv used python3.12. The world's own make setup used the system python3 (3.14.4).

Prior knowledge: this agent session started with a persistent-memory index in context whose one-line entries describe LearningOS internals (gateway write path, plan route identity, material text extraction, repository topology). The memory files were not opened, and neither scenario needed write-path knowledge, but an unfamiliar consumer would not have had this context. Oracle blindness is unaffected.

Incidental listings: listing git worktrees (to choose a worktree location) showed the names of other eval session branches (s04b, s05, s07), and listing ~/los-eval showed a conductor directory named oracle. Neither was opened or read; no oracle material was seen.

S27 reset used the protocol's reset (git reset --hard plus git clean -fd inside the world). Gitignored state from S03 survived: .venv, the installed git hooks, and the generated/derived-state projection cache (490,130 bytes). S27 therefore ran on a canonically fresh world with a warm cache and the tooling already set up; the S27 observer diff shows zero changes of any kind.
S27 ranking reused the full-corpus reading done in S03 in the same session; the reset world has identical content. The arrival-specific product searches were run fresh against the reset world.
The world's make setup, run in S03 as a consumer would, installed pre-commit, post-commit and pre-push hooks into the world's .git/hooks. These are outside git status and are not canonical changes.
The kickoff authorized computing approval values for writes the learner approves; plan C has no writes, so none were computed or needed.

Operator error outside the product and outside the world: while writing this run.json, an unquoted shell here-document made the shell execute backtick-quoted text from the draft deviation strings. This included git reset --hard and git clean -fd, run in the operator's umbrella checkout, not in the world or the LearningOS repository. No tracked file changed and nothing under LearningOS/ was touched (it is ignored there), but untracked, unignored files in that umbrella checkout were deleted. The run's evidence (the world, the observations, all records) was unaffected: the world was verified unchanged by the S27 diff taken before this happened. Reported to the owner.
